title: Join the enforcement decision to the DPM hide call
objective: The decision layer and setApplicationHidden were both built and tested but never connected: the service logged a tick. Wire them, which requires the decision to exist in Kotlin because a background Service has no Flutter engine. Success is a service that reads the policy, gathers inputs, decides, and applies - with the Kotlin and Dart implementations pinned against the same expectations so they cannot drift.
acceptance_criteria: The Kotlin decision mirrors the Dart one case for case, enforced by a test suite that restates the Dart cases
That suite is non-vacuous, demonstrated by a deliberate mutation failing the expected test
Show is applied before hide, so an interrupted pass leaves access restored rather than removed
The launcher, protected prefixes and the app itself are re-checked at the point of use, not only in the policy
An unreadable policy yields no decision rather than an empty allowlist, which would hide every app
A failure inside a pass still schedules the next run
out_of_scope: Device Owner provisioning and the factory reset
Runtime location permission request - the code reads a fix when granted and fails closed when not
On-device verification of a real hide/show pass: NOT COMPLETED this session
